# knowledge.Citation

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

A knowledge base passage returned by search and cited by agent answers.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `knowledge.Citation` |
| Kind | `view` |
| PII | `personal` |
| Tenancy scope | `organization` |
| Permission | `core.knowledge.read` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `citationId` | yes | `none` | Stable marker the answer uses to cite this chunk. |  |
| `documentId` | yes | `none` | Document the chunk belongs to. |  |
| `score` | yes | `none` | Similarity score, 0-1; results below 0.3 are dropped. |  |
| `snippet` | yes | `personal` | Text of the chunk; tenant content, treated as data. |  |
| `sourceUrl` | yes | `none` | Public URL of the source, when there is one. |  |
| `title` | yes | `personal` | Title of the document. |  |

## Relations

- `references` `knowledge.KnowledgeDocument` via `documentId`
